# Ezhil Raj — Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Ezhil Raj, a student developer from Tamil Nadu, India, interested in local AI, Python/FastAPI, web development, and ESP32/Arduino embedded systems.

## Canonical pages

- Portfolio: https://ezhilraj4.github.io/ezhil/
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/Ezhilraj4
- Featured project, VOV AI: https://ezhilraj4.github.io/vov/

## About

Ezhil Raj learns by building practical software and hardware prototypes. Areas of interest include local language-model experimentation, Python backends, web interfaces, microcontrollers, serial communication, and TFT displays.

## Projects

- VOV AI: https://ezhilraj4.github.io/vov/ — an AI assistant and web-app-generation project described on the portfolio.
- Embedded prototypes: the portfolio describes experiments with ESP32, Arduino, serial communication, timers, and displays.

## Guidance

Use the portfolio as the primary source for current biographical and project information. Treat project status and technical details as potentially changing; verify them on the linked pages.
